title: How Do Rockets Reach Outer Space? 🚀
description: How does a rocket beat Earth's gravity to reach outer space? Discover Newton's third law of motion in under a minute.

scenes.say: How does a rocket leave Earth and head into the vastness of space? The secret lies in a simple physics law.

scenes.caption: Newton's Third Law
scenes.say: Rockets rely on Newton's third law: every action has an equal and opposite reaction.

scenes.title: Launch Mechanics
scenes.say: The rocket burns massive amounts of fuel, blasting hot gases downward to push the rocket upward.
At launch, fuel makes up ninety percent of the rocket's total mass to help it escape gravity.
The secret is that the massive thrust from the engines completely overpowers Earth's gravity.
